Class JsonDetector

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.format.json.JsonDetector
All Implemented Interfaces:
FormatDetector
public class JsonDetector extends Object implements FormatDetector
The JsonDetector type matches a whole reply that is one JSON object or one JSON array. JSON is the text format of objects, arrays, and scalars. A scalar does not match. A reply that is not valid JSON does not match.

  • Method Details

    • matches

      public boolean matches(String raw)
      The matches method tests whether the whole reply is a JSON object or array. A null reply returns false. Trimmed text shorter than two characters returns false. Text that does not start with a left brace or with [ returns false. Text that the parser cannot read returns false. A parsed node matches only when it is an object or an array.
      Specified by:
      matches in interface FormatDetector
      Parameters:
      raw - The full assistant text.
      Returns:
      true only when the trimmed text is one JSON object or one JSON array.
